title: A Comprehensive Framework to Operationalize Social Stereotypes for Responsible AI Evaluations
reasoning: The framework explicitly incorporates 'religion' as a key social axis for target groups and includes 'Morality' as a primary dimension for evaluating the valence of stereotype attributes (borrowed from the ABC and SCM psychological models). It also discusses the mapping of religious stereotypes, such as those related to Hindus or Brahmins, as a core part of its evaluative taxonomy.
